instruction: Set the font size to 16 in VS Code for all files

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the font size to 16 in VSCode user settings. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings function to verify that editor.fontSize is set to 16 in the settings.json file. Similar difficulty to the original task - both involve accessing VSCode settings and modifying a single global configuration option.
